mapper.select: SELECT * FROM leetcode_problem_bank ORDER BY numeric_id ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO leetcode_problem_bank ( source_key, problem_code, numeric_id, title_main, title_alt, problem_text, solution_text, source_url, difficulty, estimated_minutes, quality_score ) VALUES ( #{sourceKey}, #{problemCode}, #{numericId}, #{titleMain}, #{titleAlt}, #{problemText}, #{solutionText}, #{sourceUrl}, #{difficulty}, #{estimatedMinutes}, #{qualityScore} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title_main = VALUES(title_main), title_alt = VALUES(title_alt), problem_text = VALUES(problem_text), solution_text = VALUES(solution_text), source_url = VALUES(source_url), difficulty = VALUES(difficulty), estimated_minutes = VALUES(estimated_minutes), quality_score = VALUES(quality_score), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE leetcode_problem_bank SET source_key = #{sourceKey}, problem_code = #{problemCode}, numeric_id = #{numericId}, title_main = #{titleMain}, title_alt = #{titleAlt}, problem_text = #{problemText}, solution_text = #{solutionText}, source_url = #{sourceUrl}, difficulty = #{difficulty}, estimated_minutes = #{estimatedMinutes}, quality_score = #{qualityScore}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
